title: Week 7
subtitle: Midseason Awards
ogDesc: The Ghoulden Globes: the Gator Tails midseason awards, the playoff bracket, and everybody's odds.

awardsIntro.title: The Ghoulden Globes
awardsIntro.body: Seven weeks in. Ten awards, one for every team, all of them earned. Tap each envelope to see who won.

awards.for: Most dead team in the league
awards.text: 0-7. The only team without a win. Would have won FOUR of those with the right lineup, most in the league. Lost by 1.4 and 3.2. Even WON his trade (Shough has 120.3 for him since) and still can't find a W. This week Brissett put up 20.6 on the bench while Bryce Young gave him 2.9. Time of death: Week 7.

awards.for: The team with no meat on it
awards.text: 818.8 points, dead last. 19-44 all-play, tied for the worst. Drake Maye has 158.1 and is the only meat on these bones. Somehow also left 183.4 on the bench, 2nd most in the league, which is impressive for a team with nothing on it.

184.3 points left on the bench, the most in the league. Three losses he would have won with the right lineup. 1-3 in games decided by less than 10. Penix sat on the bench with 29.1 in Week 6 and he lost by 2.1. Bro is riding around with no head.

Traded Javonte Williams and Carnell Tate to Nick for Garrett Wilson and Rashee Rice. Then played Nick THAT SAME WEEK. Javonte put up 21.5 against him. Garrett Wilson gave him 4.6. Rashee Rice gave him 0.0. Lost 124.2 to 78.9, the lowest score of the week (Josh Allen was on bye). All trick, no treat.

2nd most points in the league. 3rd best all-play record (40-23). Two $50 weeks. Fewest points left on the bench of anybody (74.3), so he's not even screwing up his lineup. Record: 3-4. Hanging onto the 6 seed by points. This team is haunted.

1,066.7 points scored against him, the most in the league. 2nd best all-play record and somehow only 4-3. Two $50s, including this week (179.2, Burrow 39.2), and the lowest score in the league in Week 6. Something in this house wants him dead.

5-2 with a LOSING all-play record. 3-0 in games decided by less than 10. Something is pulling the strings. The one week he finally benched all three Browns, Judkins dropped 23.4 on his bench and he lost by 62. The Browns own his soul.

5-2 with the 8th most points in the league. 22-41 all-play. Won games by 1.4 and 2.1. Then traded Sham for Javonte Williams and used him to beat Sham the same week. Luckiest team in the league by a mile. Fair Weather Fallows is robbing graves.

Drove a stake right through D. 167.0 to 121.0, D's first loss of the season. Started 0-3 and has won four straight since. Trevor Lawrence was on bye and Geno came in and dropped 30.0 like nothing happened.

awards.for: Sucking the life out of the league
awards.text: 6-1. 1,137.8 points, 76 more than anybody else. 50-13 all-play. JSN has 195.6 points, the most by any starter in the league. Even the one loss came with 44.9 sitting on his bench. Still the scariest thing in this league.
